scope: single BaTiO3 P4mm CIF; frozen 77 test q indices; two conditions; three paired seeds; fixed q predictions
interpretation_limit: No causal effect on frozen q weights; no blind confirmatory test; no real-domain or unseen-structure claim.
shared_fit_is: post-hoc test-time bounded eta solver with fixed q; it is not a learned B nuisance head
fit_cost_implication: profile optimization cost is reported separately from direct B-head inference and changes deployment significance
eta_true_policy: used only after prediction for descriptive error/correlation metrics; never passed to model, solver, fit initialization, or setting selection
q_true_policy: used only after prediction for q/lattice scores and descriptive correlation; never passed to model, solver, or fit setting selection

prior_frozen_anchors.status: frozen P3 reference values; verification anchors, not targets

fit_loss_preprocessing: expected_profile and observed inputs in max-normalized log1p_100 domain; identical renderer/loss for both methods

shared_solver.initialization_source: same canonical zero scaled nuisance coordinate for A and B; never model eta or eta_true
shared_solver.objective: mean squared error between expected_profile and supplied observed_profile, both max-normalized log1p_100
